info.title: pump.fun Developer API
info.description: Read-only social data from pump.fun for approved organisations. Every request needs an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer pf_live_...` (the header `x-api-key: pf_live_...` is accepted as an alias), never in a query string. Keys are server-only. CORS preflight (OPTIONS) requests and requests from a browser origin not on the CORS allowlist are answered before any API-key processing, so they carry no `X-Request-Id` and are not metered; the API is intended for server-side callers. Regional availability follows pump.fun: a request from a region where pump.fun is not available is refused with 403 `API_REGION_RESTRICTED` on every route.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on 429 and 503.

X-Request-Id.description: Origin-generated request id; quote it in support requests.

x-pump-api-key-id.description: Opaque id of the key that made the request, for support tickets. Never the key itself.

Deprecation.description: Present on a deprecated route: `@<unix seconds>` of the day the deprecation was announced (RFC 9745).

Sunset.description: Present on a deprecated route: the HTTP-date after which it is no longer served (RFC 8594). At least 90 days after the Deprecation date.

Link.description: Present on a deprecated route that has a replacement: `<successor>; rel="successor-version"`, the successor being its `/v1` path with this request's path parameters filled in, or an absolute URL. Resolve it against the request URL (RFC 8288).

BadRequestCredential.description: A credential of the wrong kind was sent to this host.

API_CREDENTIAL_NOT_ALLOWED.summary: A session credential was sent to the API host, or an API key was sent to the pump.fun web host. Keys work only on api.pump.fun.

value.message: A session credential was sent to the API host, or an API key was sent to the pump.fun web host. Keys work only on api.pump.fun.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed or unknown API key.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Not set by the API itself. May appear on a 401 answered in front of the API; such a reply does not carry the envelope above.

API_KEY_REQUIRED.summary: No API key was sent. Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

value.message: No API key was sent. Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

API_KEY_INVALID.summary: The key is malformed (wrong prefix, length or checksum) or unknown.

value.message: The key is malformed (wrong prefix, length or checksum) or unknown.

Forbidden.description: The key or its organisation may not call this route, or the request came from a region where the API is not available.

API_KEY_REVOKED.summary: The key was revoked. Create a new key in the developer console.

value.message: The key was revoked. Create a new key in the developer console.

API_ORG_SUSPENDED.summary: The organisation that owns the key is suspended or closed.

value.message: The organisation that owns the key is suspended or closed.

API_ORG_NOT_APPROVED.summary: The organisation has applied but is not approved yet.

value.message: The organisation has applied but is not approved yet.

API_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.summary: The key lacks the scope this route needs; `requiredScope` names it.

value.message: The key lacks the scope this route needs; `requiredScope` names it.

API_REGION_RESTRICTED.summary: The API is not available in the region the request came from. Regional availability follows pump.fun; the body names no country.

value.message: The API is not available in the region the request came from. Regional availability follows pump.fun; the body names no country.

TooManyRequests.description: A rate limit was hit; wait for `Retry-After`.

API_KEY_RATE_LIMITED.summary: A limit was hit; `window` names the ceiling (the `Error` schema lists the values) and `limit` its size. Wait `retryAfterMs` or `Retry-After`.

value.message: A limit was hit; `window` names the ceiling (the `Error` schema lists the values) and `limit` its size. Wait `retryAfterMs` or `Retry-After`.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The API could not check the key or its limits because a backing store is unavailable. Keyed calls fail closed; retry after `Retry-After` (`retryAfterSeconds` in the body says the same). The body carries no `error` code: branch on the status.

example.message: API platform temporarily unavailable; retry after 5s

Default.description: Any other error: the shared envelope. `error` is a route code from `x-error-codes`, a platform code or an HTTP reason phrase.

API_CREDENTIAL_NOT_ALLOWED.summary: Each host accepts only its own credential kind

API_KEY_INVALID.summary: The credential is not a well-formed pf_live_ key (prefix, length, charset or checksum) or no key record exists for it

API_KEY_RATE_LIMITED.summary: A key ceiling refused: the per-key burst bucket, the UTC daily limit (a limit of 0 means the key is paused; contact developers@pump.fun), the per-IP failed-auth throttle, or the per-IP lookup budget; retry after `retryAfterMs`

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until the bucket admits a request again

limit.description: The ceiling that refused: the 60-second bucket (60 x the key's per-second rate), the daily limit, the per-IP failed-auth budget, or the per-IP lookup budget

window.description: Which ceiling refused: burst (the per-key 60-second bucket), day (the per-key UTC daily limit), auth (per-IP failed authentications, charged on failed outcomes only), lookup (per-IP budget of uncached key lookups)

API_KEY_REQUIRED.summary: The keyed API host got no credential: send Authorization: Bearer <key> or x-api-key: <key>

API_KEY_REVOKED.summary: The key was revoked (by its owner or by the pump.fun team); issue a new key in the developer console

API_ORG_NOT_APPROVED.summary: The key's org application has not been approved yet (or a key is requested before approval)

API_ORG_SUSPENDED.summary: The key's org is suspended or closed, so none of its keys is served; contact developers@pump.fun

API_REGION_RESTRICTED.summary: The Developer API is not available in the region the request came from (the same regional availability as pump.fun); the body names no country

API_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.summary: The key does not hold the API scope this route needs; `requiredScope` names it

requiredScope.description: The API scope the route needs and the key does not hold

API_USER_REQUIRED.summary: The route serves the signed-in user when `user` is omitted, but an API key is never a session: send `user=<wallet or username>` when calling with an API key

CALLOUT_NOT_FOUND.summary: No callout with that id: deleted, hidden, or never existed

PARENT_REPLY_NOT_FOUND.summary: The reply being nested under does not exist: deleted, or posted too recently to have flushed

PORTFOLIO_BUILDING.summary: The wallet's portfolio is still being built and could not be served within the request's time budget; the build keeps running and a poll in a few seconds serves it

REPLY_NOT_FOUND.summary: No reply with that id: deleted, hidden, or never existed
